description: The three healthcheck scripts are structurally identical copy-pastes (same STALE_MIN=1560, same lock/backoff logic, same give-up dead-end from FIND-006) with no shared library. A fix applied to one has to be manually re-applied to the other two; as-is, all three currently share the identical give-up dead-end.

evidence.snippet: # capafy-loop-healthcheck.sh — launchd supervisor (5min). Ported from earn/clip/clip-healthcheck.sh: ... (byte-identical restart()/backoff logic to reddit-loop-healthcheck.sh and life-manager-loop-healthcheck.sh)

concreteFailureScenario: FIND-006 is fixed only in capafy-loop-healthcheck.sh (e.g. by adding a direct self-fix.sh call in the give-up branch); reddit-loop-healthcheck.sh and life-manager-loop-healthcheck.sh silently retain the original dead-end because there is no shared code path forcing consistency.
